data.title: The Caravanserai
data.text: Spoken Palestinian Arabic is learned here, the letters first and then the words. Each corner of the courtyard teaches one thing.
data.speaker: The innkeeper

data.title: The scribe’s table
data.text: Each lesson brings a few new letters, their shapes and their sounds. Pass a lesson a few times in a row to move on.
data.speaker: The innkeeper

data.title: The slate
data.text: Write the letters you’ve learned. Writing them yourself helps them stick.
data.speaker: The innkeeper

data.title: The innkeeper’s table
data.text: Everyday words, a chapter at a time. Then the regulars who use them sit down to talk.
data.speaker: The innkeeper

data.title: The fountain
data.text: Hear a sound and pick the letter that makes it. Your ears learn the letters as your eyes do.
data.speaker: The innkeeper

data.title: The echo well
data.text: Two sounds that are easy to mix up, one after the other. Listen until you can tell them apart.
data.speaker: The innkeeper

data.title: The storyteller
data.text: Read short words made of the letters you know.
data.speaker: The innkeeper

data.title: Coffee corner
data.text: Everyday phrases, a few at a time, for greeting people and getting by.
data.speaker: The innkeeper
